about_the_game:
A narrative stealth thriller where two stalkers hunt each other. Swap perspectives, manipulate evidence, and decide who becomes the prey.

Stalker X Stalker is a psychological thriller about obsession, control, and identity where two stalkers become each other’s targets. The campaign alternates perspectives hunter and hunted turning the same scenes into very different truths. Every choice leaves traces: messages, photos, missing keys, doors forced open, stares held a second too long.

Study routines, infiltrate vulnerable spaces (apartments, hospital corridors, stairwells at impossible hours), gather evidence, and build case files that can ruin a life possibly your own. The interface is diegetic: phone, notes, audio logs, hidden cameras.

This is not a monster story. It’s about ordinary people making dangerous choices, and how thin the line is between “observing” and “controlling.”

Key Features

  • Dual-Perspective Campaign – play both roles; the same moments gain different meanings.

  • Social Stealth & Infiltration – track routines, clone keys, intercept messages, craft alibis.

  • Evidence System – tag photos, notes, and audio; weave logic threads that unlock new scenes and endings.

  • Reactive AI – behaviors adapt to your sound, light, timing, and access patterns.

  • Choices with Consequences – multiple endings; trust, risk, and reputation accrue quietly.

  • Immersive Mode – minimal UI, diegetic clues, no magical waypoints.

  • Accessibility Options – scalable text, comprehensive subtitles, filters for intense effects.

Content Warnings

Mature themes: stalking, harassment, non-graphic violence, psychological abuse, panic attacks, explicit language. Realistic sound cues (footsteps, locks, breathing).

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / GeForce GT 730 / Radeon HD 7750 (OpenGL 4.1 or DirectX 11)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: 1280×720 minimum resolution; runs offline; keyboard/mouse or gamepad supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560 / Intel Iris (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: 1920×1080 recommended.

short_description: Stalker X Stalker is a stealth thriller about two people who cross the line between watching and controlling, then turn it into a battleground. The campaign flips perspectives hunter and hunted so you read routines, exploit openings, and decide how far you'll go before you become the next victim.
